tiers.label: Verified realms
tiers.short: Run by Open Vanilla, or a community realm the maintainer has vetted.
criteria: Open Vanilla's own realms are always Verified.
A community realm: listed for 14 days or more with 98% of reachability probes passing,
uses Open Vanilla sign-in (players' passwords never reach the host) and keeps backups on,
has a description and rules, no upheld reports, and its host's Open Vanilla account is in good standing,
and the maintainer approved it. The maintainer can withdraw it at any time.

tiers.label: Community P2P realms
tiers.short: Hosted by players from their own PCs. Listed after an automatic reachability check.
criteria: Heartbeats every minute and answers the directory's probe (directly or through a relay).
Name and description pass the word list; not on the blocklist.
Not vetted by a person: play at your own risk. Your Open Vanilla password never reaches the host.

tiers.label: Verified P2P nodes
tiers.short: Volunteers' relays that passed the checks and were approved by the maintainer.
criteria: Reachable: the directory's probe passes and the node proves it holds its key.
Up 95% of probes over the last 7 days, with at least 3 days of history.
Current launcher (node protocol v1), end-to-end encryption required, caps at or above the minimum.
Accepted the node rules (no logging of addresses, no inspecting or selling traffic).
No upheld reports, and the maintainer approved it. Falls back to Pending by itself if it stops passing.

official.name: relay.openvanilla.app
official.note: Open Vanilla's own relay, on the maintainer's server. Not on the leaderboard.

privacy: Opt-in. No IP addresses, node addresses, keys or account ids are published. Names appear only for supporters who chose to show one; everyone else is "Anonymous node" or not listed. Totals cover the last 30 days, rounded to 0.1 GB.
status: Test round: Open Vanilla's own relay first; volunteer nodes open after it. No supporters listed yet.
